observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: a wooden-floored dance studio with a mirrored wall, chairs, and dark red curtains
observation.dancers: one man and one woman, mixed couple
observation.formation_and_space: couples dancing in place and traveling slightly within the studio space
observation.posture: upright torso, relaxed knees, weight shifting with steps
observation.footwork: stepping patterns counted as six beats (1 and 2, 3 and 4, 5, 6), incorporating basic steps, turning basics, side passes, and weaves
observation.arms_and_hands: held in closed dance position or open hand holds, guiding turns and passes
observation.hips_and_torso: minimal hip isolation, upright torso with natural rotation during turns
observation.partnering: closed and open partner holds with lead and follow dynamics
observation.levels_jumps_turns: standing level throughout, no jumps, regular turns and rotational steps
observation.costume_and_props: man wears a cowboy hat, vest, white shirt, and jeans; woman wears a black top and black pants
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot placement details and subtle weight transfers due to camera angles and video resolution

signature_moments.what: demonstrating the basic step with a six-beat count in closed position
executing the right turning basic step
executing a side pass with the partner
